hints.title: Prime Factorization Independence
hints.text: Factorize k into prime powers p1^c1 * p2^c2 * ... Since primes are independent, solve distributions separately.

hints.title: Stars and Bars Combinatorics
hints.text: Distributing c copies of prime factor p into n positions corresponds to stars-and-bars: combinations(c + n - 1, c).

hints.title: Multiplying Combinations Modulo Prime
hints.text: Multiply combinations(ci + n - 1, ci) across all prime factors modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Factorizes k in O(sqrt(K)) and computes binomial coefficients using modular arithmetic.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating ordered integer partitions by recursion takes exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prime power independence reduces the multidimensional integer distribution to single-variable stars and bars.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Prime factorization followed by stars and bars combinatorial formula.

solutions.approach: Prime Factorization with Stars and Bars Product
